title: COBIT 2019 Foundation – ISACA
overview: The COBIT 2019 Foundation course provides an introduction to the COBIT framework for the governance and management of enterprise IT. It covers the principles, processes, and practices necessary for implementing and utilizing COBIT 2019 effectively. The course is designed to prepare participants for the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification exam and provide a solid foundation in IT governance and management.
audience: IT managers and professionals involved in IT governance.
Consultants and advisors in IT governance.
Anyone seeking foundational knowledge of COBIT 2019.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Comprehensive explanations of COBIT 2019 principles, components, and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for applying COBIT 2019 concepts.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to illustrate the application of COBIT 2019.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore COBIT 2019 challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification exam.
competencies: Risk management and control using COBIT 2019
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of the COBIT 2019 framework and its components.
To develop skills for implementing COBIT 2019 practices and processes.
To prepare participants for the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for applying COBIT 2019 in IT governance and management.
